title.zh: 代码共同方案的全局支持
title.en: Global support of coded joint plans

claim.zh: 代码方案经原生提升后，在 Within 与 Separate 下，其全部叶项请求受原生整体覆盖且无重复。
claim.en: After native lifting, a coded joint plan’s combined leaf requests are covered by the native whole without duplication under Within and Separate.

hypotheses.zh: joint_plan_lifts 的全部前提，以及支持 F 的包含、排他和叶项正确性。
hypotheses.en: All joint_plan_lifts premises plus footprint containment, exclusivity and leaf correctness.

correspondence.zh: 这是同一模型和叶项解释内的实际形式组合，不是可加预算与任意时序模型的通用转换。
correspondence.en: This is formal composition within the same model and leaf interpretation, not a universal adapter to additive budgets or arbitrary temporal models.

detail.zh: 代码实现先提升为同一原生共同方案。
detail.en: Code realization first lifts to the same native joint plan.

output.zh: 提升后的原生 Realizes，或其叶项支持定理。
output.en: Lifted native Realizes, or its leaf-support theorem.

input.zh: realized_requests_supported 消费同一原生 Realizes。
input.en: realized_requests_supported consumes that same native Realizes.

conditions.zh: 全部提升前提、Within、Separate 和叶项正确性保留。
conditions.en: All lifting premises, Within, Separate and leaf correctness remain.

detail.zh: 已实现原生方案随后给出其全部请求的根支持。
detail.en: The realized native plan then supplies root support for all requests.

output.zh: 提升后的原生 Realizes，或其叶项支持定理。
output.en: Lifted native Realizes, or its leaf-support theorem.

input.zh: realized_requests_supported 消费同一原生 Realizes。
input.en: realized_requests_supported consumes that same native Realizes.

conditions.zh: 全部提升前提、Within、Separate 和叶项正确性保留。
conditions.en: All lifting premises, Within, Separate and leaf correctness remain.

detail.zh: 不去掉排他性，也不从可用支持反向推出一般共同实现。
detail.en: It removes neither exclusivity nor the additional conditions needed for converse realization.

limitations.zh: 不去掉排他性，也不从可用支持反向推出一般共同实现。
limitations.en: It removes neither exclusivity nor the additional conditions needed for converse realization.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 复用既有二步组合，不重证叶项支持；应用时明示同一原生关系。
next_delta.en: Reuse the existing two-stage composition instead of reproving leaf support; identify the same native relation in applications.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：架构整理显式登记已有证明的输出—输入对应；无新推论或编译。
history.en: 2026-10-08: architecture repair records the existing proof’s output/input correspondence; no new inference or compilation.
